items.titleZh: 勒克莱尔和维斯塔潘回归，维斯塔潘在维修区领先！#F1 #墨西哥站
items.summaryZh: 勒克莱尔和维斯塔潘回归赛道，维斯塔潘在维修区缩小差距并领先。
items.originalTitle: It does, in come both Leclerc and Verstappen... Verstappen had closed the gap a little and takes the net lead in the pits! #F1 #MexicoGP
items.summaryEn:
It does, in come both Leclerc and Verstappen...
Verstappen had closed the gap a little and takes the net lead in the pits! #F1 #MexicoGPChris Medland: Piastri pits to swap softs for mediums, and comes out in traffic just behind Bortoleto
That might trigger more stops #F1 #MexicoGP

它确实如此，勒克莱尔和维斯塔潘都来了...
维斯塔潘缩小了差距，并在维修区取得了净领先！#F1 #墨西哥大奖赛Chris Medland：皮亚斯蒂里进维修区更换软胎，出来时刚好在博托莱托后面行驶在车流中
这可能会引发更多的进站#F1 #墨西哥大奖赛
detailEn:
It does, in come both Leclerc and Verstappen...
Verstappen had closed the gap a little and takes the net lead in the pits! #F1 #MexicoGPChris Medland: Piastri pits to swap softs for mediums, and comes out in traffic just behind Bortoleto
That might trigger more stops #F1 #MexicoGP

items.originalTitle: I'm sure you don't need reminding but just in case: As it stands Antonelli is champion He doesn't even need to finish as long as it's not a Russell or...
items.summaryEn:
I'm sure you don't need reminding but just in case: As it stands Antonelli is champion
He doesn't even need to finish as long as it's not a Russell or Hamilton victory, and he's currently P4 when a P9 is all he needs whatever happens #F1 #MexicoGP
detailZh:
我确信你不需要提醒，但以防万一：目前来看，安东内利是冠军
只要不是拉塞尔或汉密尔顿获胜，他甚至不需要完成比赛，因为他目前排在第4位，而他只需要第9位无论发生什么情况 #F1 #墨西哥大奖赛
detailEn:
I'm sure you don't need reminding but just in case: As it stands Antonelli is champion
He doesn't even need to finish as long as it's not a Russell or Hamilton victory, and he's currently P4 when a P9 is all he needs whatever happens #F1 #MexicoGP
